essence: The book closes by naming its own delivery system: part from the self, part from the śāstra, and part only from the guru — book-learning alone is mocked.
The path it delivers is one and effortless: the recognition itself, well-fitted and new, needing no yogic hardship to liberate the living.
Objections from every school are gathered, not dodged — each is shown a seat inside the recognition, and the teaching stands complete.
Lineage praised, colophons set down: the whole teaching hands itself to the Lord — one recognition, transmitted.
